verses.mawsima-huznin-c1-v1: waʿāda yawmuka lakin ʾanta lam taʿudi waghayra ṭayfika lam ʾumsik walam ʾajidi
verses.mawsima-huznin-c1-v2: kaʾanna mawsima ḥuzni ʿāda muktamila l-ʾalwāni wāmtadda bayna r-rūḥi wal-jasadi
verses.mawsima-huznin-c1-v3: lidhā ʾataytuka lā darbu ʾadussu bihi khaṭwī fāʾāthartu ʾan ʾamshī ʿalā kabidī
verses.mawsima-huznin-c1-v4: mawlāyā qad dārati l-ʾayyāmu dawratahā l-ʾukhrā wadāra binā ḥīnu mina l-ʿuqadi
verses.mawsima-huznin-c1-v5: wanaḥnu fī zamani yadhwī wakunta lahu fīmā z-zamānu rawā nabʿā mina l-baradi
verses.mawsima-huznin-c1-v6: faman ʾidhā jaffati l-ʾarwāḥu ʾaw dhabulat yafīḍu ghaymā wayadʿū: hākumu madadī
verses.mawsima-huznin-c1-v7: waʾanta yā man ʾatā bil-ḥubbi falsafaha wal-ḥubbu ʾasmā maʿānī n-nūri fī l-khaladi
verses.mawsima-huznin-c1-v8: ʾarāka fī kulli shayʾi fikrata waqafat tughālibu l-waqta fī dawwāmati l-ʾabadi
verses.mawsima-huznin-c1-v10: ʾarāka fī lamaʿāni l-māʾi fī maṭari yulāmisu l-qalba fī najmi yuḍīʾu ghadī
verses.mawsima-huznin-c1-v11: ʾarāka fī l-ḥubbi shaffāfā kaʾughniyati yamshī bihā mawkibu l-ʿushshāqi fī l-baladi
verses.mawsima-huznin-c1-v12: wifī tafāṣīli ʾayyāmi muqaddasati mā zilta taʿburuhā rūḥā bilā jasadi
verses.mawsima-huznin-c1-v13: ʾarāka fī qāmati sh-shamsi llatī nasharat mabāhija llāhi fawqa l-ʾarḍi wan-nujudi
verses.mawsima-huznin-c1-v14: kaʾannamā sh-shamsu yā mawlāyā qad ṭalaʿat likay tuḥḥaditha ʿanka n-nāsa fī saʿadi
verses.mawsima-huznin-c1-v15: ʾarāka fī shāshati l-ʾarwāḥi multamiʿā jiddā kaʾannaka kullu n-nāsi fī ʾaḥadi
verses.mawsima-huznin-c1-v17: fīhi mina l-ḥikmahi l-quṣwā taʾammuluhu fī l-khalqi, fī l-muṭlaqi l-mumtaddi lil-ʾabadi
verses.mawsima-huznin-c1-v18: fīhi mina n-nūri mā yakfī likulli fatā wafīhi mā yataḥḥadā fikrata l-ʿadadi
verses.mawsima-huznin-c1-v9: ʾarāka fī l-mawti ḥayyā khālidā waʾarā z-zamāna baʿdaka yahwī fī tharā llaḥadi
verses.mawsima-huznin-c1-v16: qad qulta qabla aktimāli ṣ-ṣamti fīka ʾalā khalīfatī ṣawtiyā l-mumtaddu fī waladī
